title: The Utter Destruction of Babylon

questions.question: Who did Jeremiah command to read the scroll containing the disasters concerning Babylon when he arrived in Babylon?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 51:59-61 (ESV): "The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah... When you come to Babylon, see that you read all these words,"

questions.question: After reading the scroll, what was Seraiah supposed to tie to it and throw into the midst of the Euphrates river?

questions.question: What was Seraiah to say as the scroll sank into the Euphrates?
options: "Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her..."
"So let the strength of Babylon be washed away..."
"The Lord has taken vengeance on the Chaldeans..."
questions.correctAnswer: "Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 51:64 (ESV): "and say, 'Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her...'"

key_verse_text: When you finish reading this book, tie a stone to it and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates, and say, "Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her, and they shall become exhausted." Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
